title: ExpertLens: Visualizing Embedding Spaces for Post-Hoc Explainability in MoE Enhanced Retrievers
abstract: arXiv:2609.06155v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural models, including dense retrievers, have been widely adopted in Information Retrieval (IR), often delivering state-of-the-art performance. Despite their effectiveness, these models operate as black boxes, limiting the interpretability of their ranking decisions. Existing post-hoc explainability methods for neural rankers primarily focus on feature-level attributions, which can be insufficient to capture the complexity of learned embedding spaces. In this work, we propose ExpertLens, a post-hoc explainability framework for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-enhanced dense retrievers that shifts focus from local scalar feature importance to representation-level global interpretability. ExpertLens leverages discriminative embedding space visualizations jointly with automatically extracted Concept Activation Vectors to reveal how expert routing drives embedding space formulation and retrieval effectiveness. translated_title: ExpertLens：面向MoE增强检索器事后可解释性的嵌入空间可视化
translated_abstract: 包括稠密检索器在内的神经模型已在信息检索（IR）领域得到广泛采用，并常常带来最先进的性能。尽管这些模型非常有效，但它们以黑盒方式运行，限制了其排序决策的可解释性。现有的针对神经排序器的事后可解释性方法主要关注特征级别的归因，这不足以捕捉所习得嵌入空间的复杂性。在这项工作中，我们提出了ExpertLens，这是一个针对专家混合增强稠密检索器的事后可解释性框架，它将关注点从局部的标量特征重要性转移到表示级别的全局可解释性。ExpertLens将判别性嵌入空间可视化与自动提取的概念激活向量相结合，以揭示专家路由如何驱动嵌入空间的构建以及检索效果。在五个IR基准上的实验（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ExpertLens框架，通过将判别性嵌入空间可视化与自动提取的概念激活向量相结合，为MoE增强稠密检索器提供从局部特征归因转向表示级别的全局事后可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ExpertLens, a post-hoc explainability framework for MoE-enhanced dense retrievers that combines discriminative embedding space visualizations with automatically extracted Concept Activation Vectors to shift from local scalar feature importance to representation-level global interpretability.
